digest.component_or_area: LLM workflow and plan review module structure
propositions: Nine modules are at or within 20 lines of the 800-LOC hard cap, blocking legitimate work (story 343b's gap-5 parameter threading requires unlandable changes to gate_dispatch.py which has only 1 line headroom)

gate_dispatch.py (799 LOC) must be split along the existing plan-review recovery call-graph seam by extracting the STEP_* constants cluster and five recovery functions into plan_review_recovery.py (~323 LOC)
orchestrator.py (796 LOC) must be split by extracting the context-assembly cluster (assemble_context, assemble_context_cache and helpers, ~194 LOC) into context_assembly.py
Both splits must preserve zero test edits and zero test failures by re-importing moved names into origin modules so existing monkeypatch and attribute-access call sites remain intact

After both splits gate_dispatch.py must have ≥100 lines headroom (target: 271) and orchestrator.py must have ≥100 lines headroom (target: 154) to unblock 343b's gap-5 wiring at three finalize_verdict call sites
